title: Workers had severe reactions to touching the craft

tellings.quote: And apparently people had severe reactions to some of the stuff just touching the craft.

plain: People working on a recovered flying craft at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, apparently had severe physical reactions just from touching it. Bob Lazar, who says he worked at S4 between 1987 and 1989 studying such craft, tells it to Michels as something he was told rather than something he saw.
